name: Speed Dating On The Citadel
source:
Set in the Citadel during its reconstruction after the events of Mass Effect 1, the player takes the role of a new C-SEC recruit as they experience their first time in the melting pot of intergalactic culture. And what better way to get acquainted with the locals than to attend that speed dating event you saw advertised?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160122070929/http://riotjayne.itch.io/speed-dating-on-the-citadell]itch.io[/url]]

Development has been canceled.
